The per-Gaussian max_t_neon (8 vld1q + 7 vmaxq + 1 vmaxvq) acted as a RAW barrier between successive apply_gaussian_neon calls because it reads the accumulator immediately after apply writes it - the compiler could not schedule the next apply's independent setup (pwr build, range-clamp, simd_exp polynomial chain, alpha cap+mul) in parallel with the previous apply's RGB writeback. Batching 4 applies before the next max-T sample exposes 3x more out-of-order issue slots between dependency-edge chains.
